points.title: 出生与成长
points.description: 老子出生于楚国苦县，这是一个位于今天的河南省鹿邑县的地方。据传，他在这里度过了他的童年和青年时期，并受到了良好的教育。老子的家庭背景不详，但他可能来自一个有文化传承的家族。他的成长经历对他后来的哲学思想产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Laozi was born in Kuxian, Chu, which is located in today's Luoyi County, Henan Province. It is believed that he spent his childhood and youth here and received a good education. The background of Laozi's family is unknown, but he may have come from a family with a cultural heritage. His upbringing had a profound impact on his later philosophical thoughts.

points.placeEn: Luoyang, the Capital of the Zhou Dynasty
points.title: 周室任职
points.description: 老子在周朝国都洛阳担任过官职。他在这个时期接触到了丰富的文化知识和政治实践，这对他形成哲学思想有着重要影响。据传，老子在周室任职期间，对当时的社会现象和政治局势进行了深刻的反思，并开始形成了他的哲学体系。
points.descriptionEn: Laozi served in the Zhou palace in the capital of the Zhou Dynasty, Luoyang. During this period, he was exposed to a wealth of cultural knowledge and political practice, which had a significant impact on the formation of his philosophical thoughts. It is said that during his service in the Zhou palace, Laozi deeply reflected on the social phenomena and political situation of the time and began to form his philosophical system.

points.title: 著书立说
points.description: 老子在函谷关著书立说，完成了《道德经》的撰写。这是他的代表作，也是道家哲学的经典之作。老子在函谷关的隐居生活，使他得以深入思考人生和社会，并将这些思考凝结成书。他的思想对后世产生了深远的影响，尤其是在中国哲学和文化领域。
points.descriptionEn: Laozi wrote and taught at Hangu Pass, completing the writing of the 'Tao Te Ching'. This is his magnum opus and a classic work of Taoist philosophy. Laozi's hermitage life at Hangu Pass allowed him to deeply contemplate life and society, and to crystallize these thoughts into a book. His thoughts have had a profound impact on posterity, especially in the fields of Chinese philosophy and culture.

appraisal.zh: 老子被尊为道家哲学的奠基人，《道德经》作为经典对后世影响深远，「无为而治」「道法自然」等观念被视为中国哲学的精髓，在学界与大众文化中他都象征着道家的智慧。另一种看法认为，其学说偏于消极，无为而治或致社会停滞，且文义时有模糊，难以具体施行。这些争议并未动摇其作为中国古代哲学重要代表的地位。
appraisal.en: Laozi is honored as the founder of Taoist philosophy, and the Tao Te Ching has exerted a profound influence as a classic; ideas such as governing without action and the Tao following its own nature are regarded as the essence of Chinese philosophy, and in scholarship and popular culture alike he symbolizes Taoist wisdom. Another view holds that his teaching is overly passive, that governing without action may lead to social stagnation, and that its ambiguities make it hard to implement concretely. Such disputes have not shaken his standing as a major representative of ancient Chinese philosophy.

supporter.zh: 老子被视为道家哲学的奠基人，他的《道德经》被奉为经典，对后世产生了深远的影响。老子倡导的‘无为而治’、‘道法自然’等思想，被视为中国哲学的精髓。
supporter.en: Laozi is regarded as the founder of Taoist philosophy, and his 'Tao Te Ching' is revered as a classic, having a profound impact on posterity. His ideas such as 'governing without action' and 'the Tao follows its own nature' are seen as the essence of Chinese philosophy.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为，老子的哲学过于消极，强调无为而治可能导致社会停滞不前。此外，他的思想也存在一些模糊不清的地方，难以具体实施。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Laozi's philosophy is too negative, emphasizing 'governing without action' may lead to social stagnation. Moreover, his ideas contain some ambiguities that are difficult to implement specifically.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，老子被视为中国古代哲学的重要代表，他的思想对后世哲学、文化、政治等领域产生了深远的影响。在大众文化中，老子常被描绘为一位智慧的长者，象征着道家哲学的精神。
objective.en: In the academic field of history, Laozi is regarded as an important representative of ancient Chinese philosophy, whose thoughts have had a profound impact on later philosophy, culture, and political fields. In popular culture, Laozi is often depicted as a wise elder, symbolizing the spirit of Taoist philosophy.

self.zh: 道可道，非常道；名可名，非常名。
self.en: The Tao that can be told is not the eternal Tao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name.
